name: All Embed – Bring Any Content into Your Elementor Designs
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Drop videos, music, maps, forms, slides, and social posts into any Elementor page in seconds – just paste a link, no code or messy iframes required.

All Embed Addons for Elementor | Documentation | Support | Demo

Why All Embed Addons for Elementor?

Embedding third-party content in WordPress usually means hunting for embed codes, wrestling with iframes, and hoping the result looks right on mobile. All Embed replaces all of that with a collection of ready-to-use Elementor widgets – paste your link, and the content appears instantly, fully responsive on phones, tablets, and desktops.

The addon covers 24+ platforms – video, audio, forms, interactive content, 360° images, music, slides, and social posts – so one lightweight plugin handles every embed on your site. It works flawlessly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro, and it is perfect for bloggers, agencies, marketers, educators, and creative professionals.

Free Features

  • Embed from 24+ Platforms: Videos, audio, forms, images, slides, prototypes, VR content, and social posts.
  • No Coding Needed: Just paste your embed link – everything works instantly.
  • Fully Responsive: All embeds automatically adapt to phones, tablets, and desktops.
  • Customizable Controls: Adjust height, width, alignment, autoplay, lazy loading, and more.
  • Seamless Elementor Integration: Works flawlessly with Elementor Free or Pro.
  • Fast & Lightweight: Minimal impact on page speed.
  • Regular Updates: New embed platforms and features added regularly.

Available Widgets

  1. YouTube Embed – Add YouTube videos to your pages with ease.
  2. Vimeo Embed – Showcase high-quality Vimeo videos.
  3. SoundCloud Embed – Embed audio tracks from SoundCloud.
  4. InVision Embed – Display interactive prototypes from InVision.
  5. JotForm Embed – Add forms created with JotForm.
  6. Google Maps Embed – Integrate interactive Google Maps.
  7. Appointly Embed – Schedule and manage appointments.
  8. Spotify Embed – Showcase music, albums, or podcasts from Spotify.
  9. Giphy Embed – Add fun and engaging GIFs from Giphy.
  10. Imgur Embed – Share images from Imgur.
  11. SlideShare Embed – Present slides from SlideShare.
  12. CodePen Embed – Showcase interactive code snippets.
  13. Twitch Embed – Stream live or recorded Twitch videos.
  14. TwitFrame Embed – Embed Twitter content dynamically.
  15. Bandcamp Embed – Share music from Bandcamp.
  16. Dailymotion Embed – Embed Dailymotion videos.
  17. Dartfish Embed – Share Dartfish sports videos.
  18. Genially Embed – Add interactive visual content from Genially.
  19. Sirv Embed – Showcase images with interactive zoom features.
  20. Mixcloud Embed – Embed audio mixes from Mixcloud.
  21. Kuula Embed – Share 360° images and VR content.
  22. Facebook Embed – Add Facebook posts, pages, or videos.
  23. Pinterest Embed – Share boards, pins, or profiles.
  24. LinkedIn Embed – Showcase LinkedIn posts or profiles.
  25. Reddit Embed – Embed posts and discussions from Reddit.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the plugin (Elementor must be installed).
  2. Open the Elementor editor on any page.
  3. Search for the “All Embed” widget category.
  4. Drag your desired widget onto the page.
  5. Paste your embed link and customize height, width, alignment, and playback controls.

Use Cases

  • Bloggers & Creators: Embed YouTube videos, Spotify playlists, and GIFs directly in articles.
  • Agencies & Marketers: Add JotForm forms, Google Maps, and social proof from Facebook or LinkedIn to landing pages.
  • Educators: Present SlideShare decks, CodePen snippets, and interactive Genially content in lessons.
  • Musicians & Podcasters: Share tracks from SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Mixcloud, and Spotify.
  • Photographers & VR Creators: Showcase 360° images and VR scenes with the Kuula widget.

sections.installation:
Note: This plugin works with Elementor. Make sure you have Elementor installed.

From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “All Embed Addons For Elementor”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open the Elementor editor and look for the All Embed widget category.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin’s .zip file to your computer.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the .zip file, click Install Now, then Activate Plugin.
  4. Open the Elementor editor and drag any All Embed widget onto your page.
sections.faq:
What platforms does this plugin support?

All Embed Addons supports 24+ platforms including YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Spotify, SlideShare, JotForm, Google Maps, Twitch, Facebook, LinkedIn, Reddit, Giphy, and many more.

Do I need coding skills to use the plugin?

Not at all. Just drag any widget into your Elementor layout and paste your embed link.

Are the embeds mobile responsive?

Yes, every widget is fully responsive and automatically adapts to all screen sizes.

Where do I find the embed widgets in Elementor?

Open the Elementor editor and search for the “All Embed” category. All widgets are grouped there.

Can I customize the embed appearance?

Yes, you can adjust height, width, alignment, autoplay, player controls, and more depending on the platform.

Will it work with the Elementor free version?

Yes, the plugin works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Do I need to install Elementor before using this plugin?

Yes. All Embed is an Elementor addon, so the Elementor page builder (free or Pro) must be installed and active on your site.

Will the embeds slow down my website?

No. The plugin is fast and lightweight with minimal impact on page speed, and widgets include a lazy loading option.

Can I embed 360° images or VR content?

Yes. The Kuula Embed widget lets you share 360° images and VR content directly inside Elementor.

Where can I get support?

Our support team is always ready to help. Visit: https://bplugins.com/support/
